headings.title: Creation and director of finance leadership
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the State Division of Finance under the management and control of the director of finance.

headings.title: Office location and full-time residency duties
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director of finance to maintain an office in Jefferson City, reside in Missouri, and devote full time to official duties.

headings.title: Transfer to department of commerce and insurance
headings.reviewNote: Assigns the division of finance by type III transfer to the department of commerce and insurance under the Omnibus State Reorganization Act of 1974.

headings.title: Construction of statutory references to division
headings.reviewNote: Provides that references in state laws, rules, or regulations to the division of finance of the department of economic development or to the division of finance refer to the division of finance of the department of commerce and insurance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 361.010 establishing the State Division of Finance, office location in Jefferson City, type III reorganization transfer to the department of commerce and insurance, and statutory reference updates.

headings.title: Execution of banking and financial laws
headings.reviewNote: Charges the division of finance with executing laws governing banks, trust companies, consumer credit, mortgage lending, and authorized financial services.

headings.title: Authority to institute and defend suits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director of finance to institute and defend legal actions in state and federal courts in the name of the state of Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.020 defining the regulatory powers of the division of finance and litigation authority of the director.

headings.title: Division seal and filing with secretary
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of finance to provide an official seal for the division of finance and file an impression with the secretary of state.

headings.title: Evidentiary effect and recording of sealed papers
headings.reviewNote: Provides that papers executed by the director and sealed with the division seal are admissible in evidence and recordable as acknowledged deeds.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.030 governing the official seal of the division of finance and evidentiary effect of sealed documents.

headings.title: Appointment of deputy director and division examiners
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of finance, with gubernatorial approval, to appoint a deputy director of finance and such examiners, assistant examiners, and other assistants as deemed necessary.

headings.title: Qualifications required for deputy director
headings.reviewNote: Requires the deputy director of finance to possess the statutory qualifications required for the director of finance.

headings.title: Duties and tenure of division employees
headings.reviewNote: Requires division employees to perform assigned duties full time and specifies that they hold office at the pleasure of the director.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.060 providing for appointment of deputy director and examiners, deputy qualifications, and employee duties and tenure.

headings.title: Oaths of office and confidentiality obligations
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director of finance and division employees to take constitutional oaths and swear not to reveal financial institution affairs except as required by law.

headings.title: Surety bonds of director and employees
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director of finance and employees to execute surety bonds to the state approved by the governor and attorney general.

headings.title: Prohibited financial interests and employment
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits the director and examining or decision-making employees, except specified state banking and savings and loan board members, from holding office, stock, gratuities, loan-negotiation roles, or indebtedness with regulated banks, trust companies, or bank holding companies.

headings.title: Internal policy on professional examiner conduct
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to establish an internal professional conduct policy for examining and decision-making employees, including procedures addressing conflicts of interest from employment offers or negotiations with regulated persons or entities.

headings.title: Subpoena power for documents and witnesses
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the director of finance to compel production of documents and witness attendance under oath in examinations and investigations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 361.070 governing oaths of office, surety bonds, conflict of interest prohibitions, professional conduct policies, and document subpoena powers.

headings.title: Confidentiality of examination and investigation facts
headings.reviewNote: Binds the director and employees under oath to keep secret information obtained in examinations or investigations, with enumerated disclosure exceptions.

headings.title: Confidentiality standards absent court compelling order
headings.reviewNote: Requires examination and investigation facts in all other circumstances to remain confidential absent a court finding of compelling reasons, with notice and intervention rights for affected institutions and defamation immunity for good faith communications.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for unauthorized disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Deems unauthorized disclosure of debtor names or examination or investigation facts by division personnel a misdemeanor punishable upon conviction by forfeiture of office and a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.080 governing confidentiality of examination facts, exceptions for supervisory disclosures, and criminal penalties for unlawful disclosure.

headings.title: Appeals from certificate or charter refusals
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to hear and determine appeals from refusals of the director of finance to grant certificates or incorporation approvals.

headings.title: Appeals from bank incorporation or relocation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to hear and determine appeals filed within ten days by adversely affected banks, trust companies, national banking associations, or other persons from director approvals of incorporation or relocation, with decisions due within ninety days.

headings.title: Procedural rules and hearing officer delegation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to establish necessary rules and authorizes delegating investigations and appeal hearings to a board member or designated hearing officer who prepares findings and recommendations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.094 governing state banking and savings and loan board appeals from director certificate refusals, incorporation approvals, and hearing officer delegation.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for appeal proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to promulgate rules consistent with law for appeal proceedings pursuant to section 536.024.

headings.title: Assessment of appeal costs against losing party
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to assess costs against the losing party and authorizes requiring a cost deposit when an appeal is brought.

headings.title: Director party status and local bank intervention
headings.reviewNote: Deems the director a party at board hearings and authorizes intervention by adversely affected persons and local financial institutions.

headings.title: Compliance with board orders and judicial review
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to act in accordance with board orders and subjects board orders to judicial review, with stay determinations made by the board.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 361.095 governing appeal procedural rules, assessment of costs, party status and intervention, and judicial review of board orders.

headings.title: Administration of oaths by board members
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the state banking and savings and loan board or any member thereof to administer oaths at appeal hearings.

headings.title: Subpoena issuance, motions to quash, and enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Governs issuance of subpoenas and subpoenas duces tecum, witness fees, motions to quash, and circuit court enforcement proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.096 governing administration of oaths and subpoena issuance and enforcement in board appeal proceedings.

headings.title: Board composition and member qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a five-member board appointed by the governor and confirmed by the senate, specifying attorney, banker, and public member requirements.

headings.title: Six-year terms, officer selection, and vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Sets six-year member terms, provides for selection of a chairman and secretary, and governs filling of unexpired term vacancies.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.097 governing board membership qualifications, partisan composition, terms of office, and officer selection.

headings.title: Per diem compensation and traveling expenses
headings.reviewNote: Provides one hundred dollars per day compensation plus necessary traveling and actual expenses paid from the division of finance fund.

headings.title: Quorum for transaction of board business
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that any three members of the board constitute a quorum for transacting business, performing duties, or exercising powers.

headings.title: Meeting locations and call of meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the board to meet anywhere in Missouri and requires it to meet upon the call of the chairman, director of finance, or any two board members.

headings.title: Official seal of the banking board
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to have an official seal bearing statutory inscription that shall be judicially noticed.

headings.title: Administrative services provided by division
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the division of finance to provide administrative services to assist the board in fulfilling statutory responsibilities.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 361.098 governing board per diem compensation, travel expenses, quorum, meeting locations, official seal, and administrative support.

headings.title: Deposit of fees and interest into fund
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director of revenue to credit incorporation fees, supervisory charges, penalties, service fees, and trust interest to the division fund.

headings.title: Appropriation restrictions on division of finance fund
headings.reviewNote: Restricts division of finance fund disbursements exclusively to general assembly appropriations for statutory powers and duties of the division.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.100 governing deposit of regulatory fees and interest into the division of finance fund and legislative appropriations.

headings.title: Surety bond requirement for money transmission
headings.reviewNote: Requires money transmission license applicants and licensees to provide and maintain a satisfactory surety bond at all times.

headings.title: Surety bond calculation and maximum amount
headings.reviewNote: Sets required security at the greater of one hundred thousand dollars or one hundred percent of average daily Missouri transmission liability for the most recent three-month period up to five hundred thousand dollars, or one hundred thousand dollars if tangible net worth exceeds ten percent of total assets.

headings.title: Exemption from daily transmission liability calculation
headings.reviewNote: Exempts licensees maintaining a five hundred thousand dollar maximum surety bond from calculating daily money transmission liability.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.1002 governing surety bond requirements, liability calculations, and maximum bond calculation exemptions for money transmission licensees.

headings.title: Maintenance of permissible investments matching obligations
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to maintain permissible investments with market value not less than aggregate outstanding money transmission obligations.

headings.title: Director authority to limit investment types
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director by rule to limit specific investment types within permissible classes if presenting undue customer risk.

headings.title: Statutory trust status of permissible investments
headings.reviewNote: Holds permissible investments in trust for purchasers and holders of outstanding transmission obligations in insolvency, bankruptcy, or receivership.

headings.title: Notice to state regulators upon trust establishment
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to notify regulators in all states where the licensee is licensed upon establishment of a statutory trust or letter draw.

headings.title: Rulemaking for additional permissible investment types
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director by rule or order to permit additional liquid, quality investment types and participate in multistate standard setting.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 361.1005 governing maintenance of permissible investments, regulatory investment limits, statutory trusts, regulatory notices, and alternative investment rules.

headings.title: Enumeration of qualifying permissible investments
headings.reviewNote: Specifies permissible investments including cash and equivalents, AAA money market funds, certificates of deposit and senior debt obligations of insured depository institutions, government obligations, excess surety bonds, and qualifying irrevocable standby letters of credit.

headings.title: Notice of letter of credit nonextension
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to demonstrate satisfactory substitute permissible investments fifteen days prior to letter of credit expiration or nonextension.

headings.title: Sight draft requirements for letters of credit
headings.reviewNote: Requires letters of credit to provide for sight draft honoring upon presentation of the original letter with amendments and a written beneficiary statement certifying bankruptcy, receivership or dissolution, emergency asset seizure, or failure to replace an expiring letter.

headings.title: Designation of agent as letter beneficiary
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to designate an agent to serve on the director’s behalf as beneficiary to a letter of credit.

headings.title: Multistate administration of letters of credit
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to participate in multistate processes for issuing and administering letters of credit, including NMLS services.

headings.title: Permissible investments subject to statutory limits
headings.reviewNote: Permits limited classes of investments including authorized delegate receivables and specified securities within statutory percentage caps.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 361.1008 enumerating permissible investment categories, letter of credit renewal notices, sight draft terms, agent designation, multistate administration, and limited permissible investments.

headings.title: Grounds for license suspension or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to suspend or revoke a money transmission license or revoke delegate designations for statutory violations, insolvency, or unsafe practices.

headings.title: Factors determining unsafe or unsound practices
headings.reviewNote: Specifies factors the director may consider in determining unsafe practices, including business size, loss magnitude, violation gravity, and prior conduct.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.1011 governing suspension or revocation of money transmission licenses and criteria for unsafe or unsound practices.

headings.title: Grounds for suspending or revoking delegate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to suspend or revoke an authorized delegate designation for statutory violations, noncooperation, felony convictions, or unfit character.

headings.title: Evaluation factors for delegate unsafe practices
headings.reviewNote: Outlines factors for determining unsafe or unsound delegate practices, including transmission volume, loss severity, violation gravity, and conduct history.

headings.title: Procedures for delegate application for relief
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes an authorized delegate to apply for relief from suspension or revocation of designation according to procedures prescribed by the director.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.1014 governing suspension or revocation of authorized delegate designations, evaluation factors, and delegate relief procedures.

headings.title: Emergency cease and desist order issuance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes immediate cease and desist orders when violations threaten irreparable harm to licensees, customers, or the public, or threaten insolvency.

headings.title: Order barring transmission through sanctioned delegate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes orders barring licensees from transmitting through an authorized delegate that is subject to a separate director order.

headings.title: Enforceability pending administrative proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a cease and desist order remains effective and enforceable pending completion of chapter 536 administrative proceedings.

headings.title: Judicial petition for temporary stay or relief
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes served licensees or authorized delegates to petition the circuit court to set aside, limit, or suspend cease and desist orders.

headings.title: Expiration of order absent timely proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that a cease and desist order expires unless the director commences chapter 536 administrative proceedings within ten days of issuance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 361.1017 governing emergency cease and desist orders against licensees and delegates, orders barring transmission through sanctioned delegates, chapter 536 enforceability, circuit court relief petitions, and ten-day order expiration.

headings.title: Class E felony for false records
headings.reviewNote: Classifies intentional false statements, misrepresentations, false certifications, or material record omissions under money transmission laws as class E felonies.

headings.title: Class E felony for commercial unlicensed transmission
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly engaging in unlicensed money transmission receiving over five hundred dollars compensation in thirty days as a class E felony.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor for unlicensed transmission
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly engaging in unlicensed money transmission receiving no more than five hundred dollars compensation in thirty days as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.1023 governing criminal penalties for fraudulent records, felony unlicensed money transmission, and misdemeanor unlicensed money transmission.

headings.title: Show cause order for unlicensed money transmission
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to issue an order to show cause why a cease and desist order should not issue against unlicensed persons.

headings.title: Emergency petition for temporary restraining order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to petition the circuit court for a temporary restraining order in emergency circumstances involving unlicensed transmission.

headings.title: Effective date of cease and desist order
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a cease and desist order issued against an unlicensed person becomes effective immediately upon service.

headings.title: Enforceability pending chapter 536 proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that an order to cease and desist remains effective and enforceable pending completion of administrative proceedings under chapter 536.

headings.title: Circuit court petition to set aside order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes an unlicensed person served with a cease and desist order to petition the circuit court for a judicial order setting aside or limiting enforcement.

headings.title: Ten-day expiration absent administrative proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Provides that an order to cease and desist against an unlicensed person expires unless administrative proceedings commence within ten days.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 361.1029 governing show cause orders against unlicensed persons, temporary restraining orders, immediate service effectiveness, chapter 536 enforcement, judicial stay petitions, and order expiration.

headings.title: Transition period protections until license renewal
headings.reviewNote: Protects existing money transmission licensees from conflicting or newly imposed requirements until their current license renewal date.

headings.title: Contract amendment schedule for authorized delegates
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to amend authorized delegate contracts only for agreements entered into or amended after the effective date or transition period.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.1035 establishing transitional protections for existing money transmission licensees and delegate contract amendment schedules.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority with board approval and notice
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director with board approval to adopt rules for banks and trust companies, requiring fifteen days advance mailing to institutions.

headings.title: Compliance with statutory administrative procedures
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no rule promulgated under this chapter becomes effective unless promulgated pursuant to the provisions of section 536.024.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.105 governing director rulemaking powers with banking board approval, notice requirements, and chapter 536 compliance.

headings.title: Definitions of bulletin and industry letter
headings.reviewNote: Defines bulletin as informal educational guidance and industry letter as a specific written position regarding regulatory facts and circumstances.

headings.title: Discretionary issuance and legal effect of bulletins
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to issue informational bulletins that do not possess the force of law and do not require formal promulgation.

headings.title: Written requests for formal industry letters
headings.reviewNote: Specifies contents required in written industry letter requests, including legal summaries, detailed facts, statutory analysis, and prospective representations.

headings.title: Binding effect and reliance protection for requester
headings.reviewNote: Makes an industry letter binding on the division as to the requesting party and bars administrative proceedings or penalties for reliance acts or omissions absent material change in fact or law or material misrepresentation or omission.

headings.title: Confidentiality of industry letter requests and responses
headings.reviewNote: Makes an industry letter request and response confidential, while allowing a published industry letter to contain nonidentifying facts and information derived from the request.

headings.title: Publication and nonbinding effect of redacted letters
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to publish redacted industry letters for informational purposes and clarifies that published letters lack force of law, are not binding on the division, and do not require rulemaking.

headings.title: Distinction from section 362.106 letters
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that industry letters issued under section 361.106 are distinct from letters issued by the director under subdivision (5) of section 362.106, which remain governed by that section.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsection headings for 361.106 defining bulletins and industry letters, discretionary bulletin issuance, industry letter request contents, binding effect and reliance protection, confidentiality, permissive publication of redacted letters, and distinction from section 362.106 letters.

headings.title: Weekly posted statement of division work
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director, or deputy director in the director's absence or inability to act, to post by 5:00 p.m. each Monday or next non-holiday day a signed statement on the division website detailing fourteen categories of division actions since the preceding statement.

headings.title: Public retention and online availability of statements
headings.reviewNote: Requires the division of finance to retain all weekly statements as public documents open to public inspection at all reasonable times and available on a publicly accessible division website.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.110 requiring weekly website posting of detailed division work statements and public record retention of those statements.

headings.title: Virtual Currency Kiosk Consumer Protection Act title
headings.reviewNote: Designates section 361.1100 as the Virtual Currency Kiosk Consumer Protection Act.

headings.title: Definitions of virtual currency and kiosk terms
headings.reviewNote: Defines fifteen statutory terms including Bank Secrecy Act, blockchain, blockchain analytics, digital wallet, fiat currency, NMLS, United States PATRIOT Act, virtual currency, virtual currency kiosk, and virtual currency kiosk operator.

headings.title: Confidentiality of kiosk regulatory records
headings.reviewNote: Makes operator reports and division examination or investigation records confidential and exempt from chapter 610 disclosure, while identifying public operator contact, registered agent, and final order records.

headings.title: Federal law supremacy in kiosk regulation
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that applicable federal laws, including the Bank Secrecy Act and United States PATRIOT Act, govern to the extent of any statutory inconsistency.

headings.title: Compliance evidence requests and record production
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to request evidence of compliance with this section and applicable law, and requires operators to provide all records the director may reasonably require.

headings.title: Mandatory material risk disclosures to customers
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators prior to an initial transaction to provide clear written English disclosures of all material risks of virtual currency, including ten enumerated risk warnings.

headings.title: Account opening terms and conditions disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators when opening a new customer account prior to an initial transaction to disclose all relevant terms and conditions, including unauthorized transaction liability, third-party disclosures, statement and receipt rights, and prior notice of policy changes.

headings.title: Mandatory customer fraud warning notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators to display a specific prominent fraud and scam warning notice to customers prior to executing transactions.

headings.title: Receipt requirements for kiosk transactions
headings.reviewNote: Directs operators upon completing a kiosk transaction to provide a digital or physical receipt stating operator contact and complaint telephone details, transaction type, value, date and local time, fee, applicable exchange rate, nondelivery liability, and refund policy.

headings.title: Mandatory blockchain analytics software implementation
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators to utilize blockchain analytics software to prevent virtual currency transfers to known fraudulent digital wallets.

headings.title: Live customer service operating requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators to provide live customer service Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. with toll-free display.

headings.title: Written anti-fraud policy and detection controls
headings.reviewNote: Directs operators to establish and maintain comprehensive written policies and technical procedures to detect and prevent consumer fraud.

headings.title: Enhanced due diligence policy and governing approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators to maintain, implement, and enforce a board-approved written enhanced due diligence policy that at minimum identifies individuals at risk of fraud based on age or mental capacity.

headings.title: Statutory compliance and written compliance policies
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators to comply with this section and all applicable federal and state laws, and requires each kiosk to maintain, implement, and enforce board-approved written compliance policies and procedures.

headings.title: Designation and qualifications of compliance officer
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators to designate and employ a qualified full-time compliance officer owning no more than twenty percent of the operator, and requires federal and state compliance responsibilities to be completed by full-time employees.

headings.title: Designation of consumer protection officer
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators to designate and employ a qualified full-time consumer protection officer to coordinate and monitor statutory and legal compliance who owns no more than twenty percent of the operator.

headings.title: Quarterly kiosk location reports to division
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators within forty-five days after each calendar quarter to report each Missouri kiosk location's legal and trade names, physical address, and start and end dates using a director-formulated system.

headings.title: Licensure requirement under money transmission law
headings.reviewNote: Deems virtual currency kiosk operators engaged in money transmission requiring licensure under sections 361.900 to 361.1035, sets a sixty-day application window after August 28, 2025 with interim operation and cessation upon denial, and notes the source footnote that 'operators' appears in original rolls of H.B. 754, 2025.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for virtual currency kiosks
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the division of finance to promulgate implementing rules subject to chapter 536 and section 536.028, with nonseverability voiding rules adopted after August 28, 2025 if legislative review powers are held unconstitutional.

headings.title: Ten-year retention and permanent records preservation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of finance to preserve division records for ten years and permanently maintain records of enduring value.

headings.title: Destruction and disposal of obsolete records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director of finance to destroy or dispose of division records after the ten-year retention period as provided by law.

headings.title: Periodic and special reports of condition
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to require regular periodic condition reports from supervised financial institutions, authorizes requiring special reports, and requires verified reports in director-prescribed forms.

headings.title: Designation of reporting dates twice yearly
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director at least twice annually to designate a reporting day for supervised banks and trust companies and serve notice by delivery or prepaid mail.

headings.title: Acceptance of federal regulatory report data
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to obtain condition data from federal bank regulators in lieu of direct filing, with supplemental verification.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.130 governing periodic reports of condition, designation of reporting dates, and acceptance of federal agency data.

headings.title: Annual examinations of banks and trust companies
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual examinations of banks, trust companies, and reporting corporations, except eighteen-month intervals for Camel/MOECA 1 or 2 rated institutions and thirty-six-month intervals for private trust companies, and authorizes reliance on other states', FDIC, Federal Reserve, or CPA audit reports.

headings.title: Discretionary, foreign agency, and out-of-state branch exams
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the director or designated examiners to examine supervised corporations whenever deemed necessary or expedient, as well as Missouri agencies of foreign banking corporations and Missouri branches of out-of-state banks.

headings.title: Administration of oaths and compelling attendance
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the director, deputy, and examiners to administer oaths and compel the appearance and attendance of any person whose testimony is required in an examination or investigation.

headings.title: Scope of inquiry into financial condition
headings.reviewNote: Specifies examination scope including capital condition, resource safety, management prudence, investment legality, and statutory compliance.

headings.title: Special investigations of statutory violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to make special investigations to determine whether individuals or corporations have violated banking laws.

headings.title: Examinations continuing after taking possession
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to institute or continue examinations and inquiries after taking possession until resumption or liquidation.

headings.title: Certification of examination results on records
headings.reviewNote: Requires the results of each examination to be certified by the director or examiner upon the records of the examined institution.

headings.title: Interstate regulatory agreements for branch examinations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes contracts with out-of-state banking regulators to examine interstate branches and provide for cost-sharing arrangements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsection headings for 361.160 governing periodic institution examinations, discretionary foreign agency and out-of-state branch examinations, oath administration and attendance, scope of inquiry, violation probes, post-possession examinations, record certifications, and multistate agreements.

headings.title: Annual regulatory expense assessment on institutions
headings.reviewNote: Provides for annual proportional assessments upon banks and trust companies to fund division operating expenses, payable semiannually.

headings.title: Reimbursement of extraordinary and special expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to pay expenses incurred or services performed outside normal annual or special examination costs, and directs annual review and revision of fees for other regulated corporations to recover costs.

headings.title: Salary schedule and federal parity comparison
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to maintain examiner salary schedules not exceeding ninety percent of federal regulatory parity for similar positions.

headings.title: Division of finance fund dedication and carryover
headings.reviewNote: Creates the dedicated Division of Finance Fund and applies unexpended balances to reduce succeeding assessments rather than transferring to general revenue, except that up to fifteen percent for supporting services and fringe benefits not directly allocated to the fund shall be returned to general revenue.

headings.title: Consumer licensing fund administration and investment
headings.reviewNote: Creates the dedicated Consumer Licensing Fund for non-depository regulatory fees, managed by the state treasurer without biennium lapse.

headings.title: Bond liability for false solvency reports
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes injured persons to bring an action on the official bond of the director or examiner for knowing and wrongful solvency reporting.

headings.title: Action brought in name of state
headings.reviewNote: Requires actions on official bonds for false solvency reports to be brought in the name of the state at the relation of the injured party.

headings.title: Trustee authority for unclaimed liquidation sums
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to take and hold in trust unclaimed sums due creditors, depositors, or stockholders after liquidation.

headings.title: Receipt and deposit of unclaimed funds
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to receipt for unclaimed moneys received when not in possession and deposit them in trust in solvent banks.

headings.title: Deposit timing following liquidation distribution order
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to deposit unclaimed liquidation moneys at the expiration of six months following the final distribution order.

headings.title: Priority of unclaimed deposit funds in insolvency
headings.reviewNote: Grants statutory priority of payment to director unclaimed deposits on equal terms with other priorities in depositary insolvency.

headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to maintain an official index of persons entitled to unclaimed deposits, dividends, or interest held in trust.

headings.title: Payment to claimants showing lawful entitlement
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to identify the holding corporation upon satisfactory evidence of lawful entitlement, or authorizes paying over funds held by the director in trust.

headings.title: Court orders in doubtful claims and immunity
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes requiring circuit court orders for disputed claims and shields the director from liability for good-faith disbursements.

headings.title: Application and investigation for branch office
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to investigate branch applications regarding public convenience, advantage, and required paid-in capital compliance.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate authorizing branch office
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director, if satisfied that granting a branch application is expedient and desirable, to issue a certificate under hand and official seal specifying opening date, conditions, and location.

headings.title: Grounds for refusal of branch application
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to refuse branch applications found inexpedient or lacking capital, with state bank branching restrictions.

headings.reviewNote: Requires persons seeking control, in cooperation with the licensee, to submit an application in a form and medium prescribed by the director together with a nonrefundable fee.

headings.title: Director permission to submit without using NMLS
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director upon request to permit applicants to submit control acquisition information without utilizing NMLS.

headings.title: Key individual disclosures in control application
headings.reviewNote: Requires control applications to include fingerprint and background information under section 361.939 for new key individuals.

headings.title: Facial completeness review of control application
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to promptly notify applicants when an application for acquisition of control facially appears complete.

headings.title: Processing acceptance effect on substantive approval
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that an application completeness determination means only facial receipt of required items and is not substantive approval.

headings.title: Investigation of acquiring person character and fitness
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to investigate financial responsibility, experience, and character of acquiring persons prior to approval.

headings.title: Acceptance of lead investigative state results
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director under multistate licensing to accept investigation results from a qualified lead investigative state.

headings.title: Written notice of denial of control application
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to issue written notice setting forth specific reasons within thirty days of denying a control application.

headings.title: Exemptions from prior control approval requirements
headings.reviewNote: Exempts specified transactions from prior control approval, including proxy voting, devise or descent, fiduciaries or court-appointed officers, section 361.909(7) exempt persons, public-interest determinations, public securities offerings, and internal reorganizations retaining ultimate control.

headings.title: Post-acquisition notice for specified exempt transactions
headings.reviewNote: Requires persons acquiring control under specified exemptions to notify the director within fifteen days after the transaction.

headings.title: Streamlined approval for previously approved controlling persons
headings.reviewNote: Provides streamlined approval for persons previously approved under money transmission laws who meet regulatory standing criteria.

headings.title: Advance written determination of control status
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes persons to request a written determination from the director regarding whether a transaction constitutes acquisition of control.

headings.title: Lead state authority in control determinations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to accept or perform multistate control determinations as a lead investigative state under national standards.

headings.title: Notice and background requirements for key individuals
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to provide notice within fifteen days and background information within forty-five days of appointing key individuals.

headings.title: Director authority to issue notice of disapproval
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director within ninety days of complete notice to disapprove key individuals lacking competence or integrity.

headings.title: Disapproval notice contents and administrative appeal
headings.reviewNote: Requires disapproval notices to state specific grounds and authorizes administrative appeals pursuant to chapter 536 within thirty days.

headings.title: Deemed approval upon expiration of review period
headings.reviewNote: Provides that key individuals are deemed approved if not disapproved within ninety days after the notice is determined complete.

headings.title: Multistate review and lead state determination acceptance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to accept or conduct multistate key individual determinations as a lead investigative state.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 361.954 governing notice of key individual changes, director disapproval authority, disapproval appeals, deemed approval timing, and multistate review processes.

headings.title: Quarterly condition report filing deadline
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to submit reports of condition within forty days following the end of each calendar quarter.

headings.title: Contents of condition report and NMLS submission
headings.reviewNote: Specifies condition report contents including financial statements, nationwide transaction data, and permissible investment reports via NMLS.

headings.title: Annual fourth quarter destination country reporting
headings.reviewNote: Restricts transaction destination country reporting requirements to fourth-quarter condition reports submitted within forty-five days.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.957 governing quarterly reports of condition, required contents and NMLS reporting, and annual destination country disclosures.

headings.title: Annual audited financial statement filing deadline
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to file audited annual financial statements prepared under GAAP within ninety days following fiscal year end.

headings.title: Independent certified public accountant qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires audited financial statements to be prepared by an independent certified public accountant satisfactory to the director.

headings.title: Auditor certificate of opinion and qualification remedies
headings.reviewNote: Requires an accompanying accountant certificate of opinion and authorizes orders to remove qualifications from qualified opinions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.960 governing annual audited financial statements, independent accountant qualifications, and accountant certificate opinions.

headings.title: Quarterly reporting deadline for authorized delegates
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to submit a report of authorized delegates within forty-five days after each calendar quarter and authorizes the director to utilize NMLS for submission.

headings.title: Required delegate identifying data and dates
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required delegate reporting details including legal name, tax ID, physical address, business locations, and start dates.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.963 governing quarterly authorized delegate reports and required identification data.

headings.title: One-day notice for bankruptcy or revocation actions
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to report within one business day bankruptcy or reorganization filings, receiverships, dissolution proceedings, creditor assignments, or license revocation or suspension proceedings in any state or country.

headings.title: Three-day notice of key individual felony convictions
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice within three business days if a licensee, key individual, controlling person, or delegate is convicted of a felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.966 governing one-day reporting of bankruptcy and license revocations, and three-day reporting of felony convictions.

headings.title: Three-year record retention period for transactions
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to maintain for at least three years records of sold, outstanding, and paid money transmission obligations, monthly general ledgers, bank statements and reconciliations, authorized delegate contact lists, and other records required by rule.

headings.title: Permissible form of maintained records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes licensees to maintain required compliance records specified in subsection 1 in any form of record.

headings.title: Production of records kept outside this state
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes maintaining required records outside Missouri if made accessible to the director on seven business days' notice sent in a record.

headings.title: Records open to inspection by director
headings.reviewNote: Provides that all records maintained by a licensee under subsections 1 to 3 are open to inspection by the director under subsection 1 of section 361.921.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 361.972 governing three-year licensee record retention, permissible record forms, out-of-state record access on seven business days' notice, and director inspection authority.

headings.title: Definition of remit for authorized delegates
headings.reviewNote: Defines 'remit' as making direct payments of money to a licensee or its authorized representative or depositing money in a bank account specified by the licensee.

headings.title: Prerequisites before using an authorized delegate
headings.reviewNote: Requires a licensee before operating through an authorized delegate to adopt written compliance policies, execute a compliant written contract under subsection 4, and conduct a risk-based background investigation.

headings.title: Authorized delegate duty of full compliance
headings.reviewNote: Requires every authorized delegate to operate in full compliance with sections 361.900 to 361.1035.

headings.title: Mandatory terms of authorized delegate contract
headings.reviewNote: Specifies nine mandatory signed contract terms covering delegate appointment, scope, state and federal legal compliance, remittance, trust status, recordkeeping, examination consent, director suspension authority, and receipt of written policies (noting the source footnote that 'subsection 1' appears in original rolls for subsection 2).

headings.title: Delegate notice and cessation upon license loss
headings.reviewNote: Requires a licensee within five business days of license suspension, revocation, surrender, or expiration to document notice to listed authorized delegates, who must immediately cease money transmission.

headings.title: Trust fund status of delegate transmission proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Declares all transmission proceeds received by authorized delegates to be held in trust for the benefit of the licensee.

headings.title: Prohibition against authorized delegates using subdelegates
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits authorized delegates from utilizing subdelegates to conduct money transmission on behalf of a licensee.

headings.title: Circuit court injunctive relief against delegates
headings.reviewNote: Empowers circuit courts in licensee actions to grant equitable or legal relief including prohibiting delegates and ordering restitution or damages for failure to remit under section 361.975(2), noting the source footnote that nonexistent section 361.1275 appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Mandatory licensee report of court order to director
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees obtaining court orders prohibiting delegates to report the orders to the director within thirty days and through NMLS within ninety days.

headings.title: Class E felony for unremitted trust funds
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly failing to remit more than one thousand dollars of transmission trust funds as a class E felony.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor for smaller trust defaults
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly failing to remit one thousand dollars or less of transmission trust funds as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Forwarding transmission funds according to agreement terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to forward money received for transmission pursuant to agreement terms absent reasonable belief of unlawful conduct.

headings.title: Response to sender inquiries explaining transmission failure
headings.reviewNote: Directs licensees failing to forward money to respond to sender inquiries stating reasons unless disclosures violate law.

headings.title: Exemptions from statutory consumer refund requirements
headings.reviewNote: Exempts transactions subject to the federal Remittance Rule or commercial agreements to process payments for goods or services.

headings.title: Mandatory refunds within ten days of request
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to refund transmission moneys within ten days of written request unless funds forwarded or fraud suspected.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 361.987 exempting federal remittance rules and commercial contracts, and mandating refunds within ten days of written request.

headings.title: Exemptions from statutory transaction receipt requirements
headings.reviewNote: Exempts remittance rule transactions, non-consumer transactions, commercial merchant processing, and payroll processing services from section requirements.

headings.title: Permissible forms and delivery methods for receipts
headings.reviewNote: Defines receipt as a paper receipt, electronic record, or written confirmation, permits electronic receipts upon sender request or agreement for in-person transactions or for electronic or phone transactions, and requires retainable electronic form.

headings.title: Mandatory receipt disclosures and language requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires receipts to detail sender, recipient, date, unique ID, fees, taxes, and amounts in English and advertising languages.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 361.990 exempting federal remittance rules and payroll services, defining receipts, and establishing mandatory receipt contents.

headings.title: Mandatory payroll client reports and worker paystubs
headings.reviewNote: Requires payroll processing licensees to provide advance obligation reports to clients and deliver paystubs or equivalent statements to workers.

headings.title: Exemption when client provides required disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Exempts licensees from paystub disclosures if clients designate recipients and assume contractual responsibility for delivering statements.

headings.title: Appointment of agents for payroll processing services
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes licensees to appoint payroll agents under written agreements preserving licensee liability for proper fund remittance.

headings.title: Minimum tangible net worth tier requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to maintain tangible net worth of the greater of one hundred thousand dollars or three percent of the first one hundred million dollars in assets, two percent from one hundred million to one billion dollars, and one-half percent over one billion dollars.

headings.title: Demonstration of net worth at initial application
headings.reviewNote: Requires net worth demonstration at initial application through recent audited or unaudited financial statements.

headings.title: Director authority to exempt net worth requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director for good cause shown to exempt any applicant or licensee from net worth requirements in whole or part.
